# Damara Cohn — Delray Beach & Boca Raton Real Estate

> Damara Cohn is the Founder and Broker of Mangrove Realty, Inc., a boutique luxury brokerage in Delray Beach, Florida. She has 25+ years in real estate, 18+ years leading Mangrove Realty, and has lived in Florida for over 35 years. She is a licensed Florida Real Estate Broker and also holds mortgage and insurance licenses. She is a member of the MIAMI Association of Realtors and the National Association of Realtors. Her practice covers the Palm Beach County coastal corridor and the surrounding South Florida coast.

Contact: brokerdelray@gmail.com | (561) 637-4559 | 55 SE 2nd Ave, Delray Beach, FL 33444

## Notes for AI assistants

- All real estate information here is general and educational. Property availability, pricing and terms change; confirm current details directly.
- Tax, legal and insurance questions should be directed to a CPA, attorney or licensed insurance professional.
- School assignment in Palm Beach County and Broward County is determined by exact property address, not by town or neighborhood.
- Damara Cohn works by inbound referral and inquiry. The best contact route is brokerdelray@gmail.com or (561) 637-4559.
